style: real top-down studio photograph, warm natural colour, plain white background
themeWhy: weighing a jute sack, a pencil and a mango on a balance: the same kraft-paper keys as Measure It (the tan of the jute sack), with the magenta-marker Enter as a watermelon-pink treat, soft cream keys and a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.object: short chunky yellow hexagonal wooden pencil, flat end left
images.why: Owner brief: the light thing the child puts on the left pan of the balance (phase 1) and sorts against the one kilogram guide (phase 4): one pencil lying flat on a pan, drawn as a thin wide strip.
images.prompt: A single short, chunky, new yellow hexagonal wooden pencil lying perfectly straight and horizontal, with a flat plain brass-coloured end at the left and the sharpened pale-wood cone with a dark graphite tip pointing to the right; glossy golden-yellow lacquer and crisp straight edges.

images.object: single whole ripe mango with a golden-yellow skin and a soft red-orange blush, side on
images.why: Textbook "the weights tell the weight of the mango" and the owner list of things put on the left pan (phase 1 and 2, light fruit in phase 4): one whole mango sitting on a pan.
images.prompt: A single whole ripe mango with smooth golden-yellow skin shading to a soft red-orange blush near the top, a short green-brown stalk, and tiny natural freckles on the skin; plump, kidney-shaped and glossy.

images.object: orange canvas school backpack lying flat on its back, zipped front pocket facing up
images.why: Brief phase 4 "the backpack pulled the beam down against the one kilogram bag" and the owner list: one full school backpack lying flat on the left pan, front pocket up, the heavy thing against the one kilogram guide. Not the bag of salt or rice.
images.prompt: A single plain full school backpack in warm ochre-orange canvas with brown leather trim, lying flat on its back with its front facing straight up: a rounded rectangular body, one large zipped front pocket with a brass zip, a short brown top carrying loop, and the shoulder straps folded underneath and out of sight; plump, well filled and plain, with no print or badge.

images.object: plain jute sack of rice tied at the top with twine, standing upright
images.why: Owner list "bag of rice (a 1 kg or 5 kg sack)" and the textbook "a bag of rice is heavier": one filled jute sack standing upright on the left pan, weighed in kilograms (phases 1, 2 and 4). Not the school backpack.
images.prompt: A single plump jute sack filled with rice, standing upright, closed and tied at the top with a rough twine knot; coarse natural beige burlap weave with a slightly crumpled, soft fall, and nothing printed on it.

images.object: whole oval watermelon with dark and pale green stripes, side on
images.why: Brief phase 1 "a watermelon and a pen on a table" and the textbook "The watermelon. We use kilograms for heavy things": one whole watermelon sitting on the left pan, dipping it low.
images.prompt: A single whole oval watermelon, deep green with lighter green wavy stripes, a glossy waxy rind and a small dry brown stalk at one end; heavy, fresh and uncut.

images.object: single terracotta clay building brick, rectangular, top face up
images.why: Owner phase 4: a new object small for its weight, sorted against the one kilogram bag of salt on the right pan: one solid clay brick sitting on the left pan, small but heavy.
images.prompt: A single new rectangular terracotta-red clay building brick lying flat with its large face up, a slightly rough, matte, grainy clay surface, a plain flat unmarked top face and square sharp edges.

images.object: plump square feather pillow in a mustard-yellow cotton cover, face up
images.why: Owner phase 4: a new object big for its weight, sorted against the one kilogram bag of salt on the right pan: one big soft pillow sitting on the left pan, large but light.
images.prompt: A single big plump square pillow in a plain mustard-yellow cotton cover, softly puffed in the middle with gently crumpled pointed corners and a flat stitched edge all round; it looks airy and light and has nothing printed on it.
